sources.title: A Sanity Check for AI-generated Image Detection - GitHub
sources.snippet: We conduct a sanity check on "whether the task of AI-generated image detection has been solved". To start with, we present Chameleon dataset, consisting AI-generated images that are genuinely challenging for human perception.
